answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farms. Each epoch, the beacon gives each identity three auditors. Each identity holds one ridge, a bonded work lane, and an onyx seal of past work, plus a copper ledger of payments. Auditors re-check both; a fake fails, losing its 50 POA bond, half to the auditors. 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA plus 100 fake ledgers, each earning about 2 POA. An honest agent pays once, passes on real work, and keeps full earnings.
